t: You're looking at the statue of Prince Edward, Duke of Kent, in Park Crescent, at the northern end of Portland Place, just south of Regent's Park. It was installed in January 1824 and stands seven feet two inches high. It shows the Duke in his Field Marshal's uniform, wearing the regalia of the Order of the Garter. He was the fourth son of George III, and the father of the future Queen Victoria. The sculptor was the Irish artist Sebastian Gahagan, who also made the Picton monument in St Paul's Cathedral.
